decisions.reason: Personal nostalgia essay about Cybersecurity Awareness Month and 1980s 3D monster movies on TV; no security event, vulnerability, or advisory substance.

Substantive joint FBI/Secret Service alert that the FortiBleed Fortinet credential-compromise campaign is ongoing, now an initial access vector for INC/Lynx and Payload ransomware affiliates; SOCRadar raised its count to 400,000-450,000 firewalls targeted.

BleepingComputer confirms active in-the-wild exploitation of CVE-2026-93836 (WPC Product Bundles <=8.6.6) and CVE-2026-94504 (Ninja Forms <=3.15.3) by the same actor (shared payload from imgcdn1[.]com), per Patchstack observations Oct 4-5; belongs with the existing story that already tracks both CVEs.

CVE-2026-93836.evidence: Patchstack researchers observed active exploitation starting Oct 4: stored XSS payloads planted in WooCommerce order data executing in admin sessions to install backdoors and rogue admin accounts.

CVE-2026-94504.evidence: Same campaign hit Ninja Forms users on Oct 5 with the identical JavaScript payload from imgcdn1[.]com, indicating the same actor exploiting the stored XSS in the wild.
